messages:
Kelsey: Tiny weekend poll — lazy Saturday double feature. Pick one ALBUM to set the vibe for two movies. Example: Massive Attack — Mezzanine with Blade Runner 2049 + Drive. Keep it short, vote with album + movies.
Miguel: Mezzanine — Blade Runner 2049 / Drive. moody synth, perfect. :thumbsup:
Priya: Sufjan Stevens — Illinois — Moonrise Kingdom / Paterson. soft, intimate. :herb:
Sam: Boards of Canada — Music Has the Right to Children — Stalker / Under the Skin. weirdly hypnotic.
Jen: Queens of the Stone Age — Songs for the Deaf — Mad Max: Fury Road / Baby Driver. loud + adrenalined.
Dana: Radiohead — In Rainbows — Her / Eternal Sunshine. warm and melancholy.
Ravi: I'm team 'bring snacks' but if I must: Belle & Sebastian — If You're Feeling Sinister — Amélie / Lost in Translation. Also bringing popcorn :popcorn:
music-bot: Poll created. React with 1️⃣-6️⃣ to vote. Options: 1) Mezzanine — BR2049/Drive; 2) Illinois — Moonrise/Paterson; 3) Boards of Canada — Stalker/Under the Skin; 4) QOTSA — Fury Road/Baby Driver; 5) In Rainbows — Her/Eternal Sunshine; 6) Belle & Sebastian — Amélie/Lost in Translation
Kelsey: also curious if anyone has a streaming playlist link? spotify links pls
Miguel: here's a quick Mezzanine link: https://open.spotify.com/album/3w8v...
Priya: I made a tiny playlist for Moonrise/Paterson vibes — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1xYz...
Sam: quick note — if you want ominous ambient, play at low volume and open subtitles, it's peak.
Jen: vote cast :one: (for Miguel) and I'll bring spicy chips.
Dana: :two: (for Priya) and I'll bring tea.
Ravi: :six: because snacks > everything.
Kelsey: nice! winner decided by snacks tiebreaker. movie night at my place 8pm Saturday? @everyone
music-bot: Reminder set for Saturday 20:00. RSVP thread: :calendar:
